name: Non Create Addon
description: A companion addon for NeedsofNature and Create. Adds an andesite alloy recipe (2 iron ingots + 2 liquid bottles -> 9 andesite alloy), a rose quartz recipe (1 liquid bottle + 8 redstone -> 9 rose quartz) and a brass recipe (1 copper ingot + 200 mB of liquid in a heated mixer -> 2 brass ingots), disabling the original Create recipes for all three. Makes the horse liquid collector emit a redstone pulse in a 3x3 area once its animation has finished, so the collector can be automated, and lets a dry-handed player take the liquid bottle out of a full collector. Recolours drained liquid bottles so every liquid matches that one recipe, and adds the non-create-addon:animation_speed status effect: at level 1 / 2 / 3 a NoN animation plays 1.5x / 2x / 2.5x faster and lasts correspondingly less. Wearing Create's cardboard armor grants one level per piece.
